[Page 1]
NexaWorks | Synthetic RFP response
Page 1
 NexaWorks
Fictional supplier proposal | RFP-2026-PORTAL
SYNTHETIC CLASSROOM DATA - All organizations, projects, contacts and claims in this proposal are invented.
1. Executive summary and requirement
The buyer seeks a cloud supplier-onboarding and procurement portal for 500 staff. The common scope is
approval workflows, ERP connectivity, SSO, reporting, data migration and administrator training. Each bidder
must describe capacity, delivery, total costs and operational support.
NexaWorks proposes delivery in 12 weeks at a fixed implementation price of INR 18,50,000. The following
sections state our offered scope and limitations.
2. Proposed solution
The solution uses documented REST adapters, a staging environment and automated contract tests. Capacity
planning targets 1,000 concurrent users; larger workloads require a separate sizing exercise.
The base scope covers supplier registration, approval routing, purchase-request tracking and a reporting
dashboard. Buyer staff supply clean master data and approve requirements. New third-party licensing is
excluded unless explicitly priced.


[Page 2]
NexaWorks | Synthetic RFP response
Page 2
3. Delivery, team and milestones
A 12-week plan defines discovery, prototype, integration, migration rehearsal and acceptance gates. A RACI
assigns a delivery manager, integration lead, three engineers and a QA lead. A two-week risk reserve and
weekly risk register reviews are included.
The buyer must provide an ERP sandbox, an identity-provider test account and a product owner. Scope changes
require a written estimate and approval. Acceptance requires successful user journeys and resolution of critical
defects.
4. Commercial proposal
Item
Offer
Implementation (fixed)
INR 18,50,000
Delivery schedule
12 weeks
First-year support
Included in fixed price
Tax
GST excluded
Cloud hosting
Buyer account; usage billed separately
Payment milestones
30% kickoff / 40% build / 30% acceptance
Assumptions: one ERP instance, English interface and one data migration are included. Travel, custom mobile
apps and ongoing cloud consumption are excluded. Renewal pricing after year one is subject to a new quote; this
is a total-cost uncertainty.


[Page 3]
NexaWorks | Synthetic RFP response
Page 3
5. Security, compliance and risk
SSO, least-privilege roles, encrypted backups and immutable audit logs are included. Recovery targets are RPO
24 hours and RTO 8 hours. Annual penetration testing is planned; no completed certification is claimed.
All claims are illustrative. The buyer should validate security evidence before any real procurement. Key shared
risks include delayed sandbox access, poor source data and unapproved scope changes. The supplier will
record issues and escalate unresolved dependencies to the buyer sponsor.
6. Support, experience and references
24x7 incident intake provides a 1-hour critical response and named escalation owner. Three fictional comparable
projects include reference contacts, transition training and monthly service reviews.
Fictional reference directory: Cedar Training Cooperative, Mira Shah, reference@cedar.example; Blue Lake
Services, Arun Das, reference@bluelake.example. These are invented classroom contacts and must not be
contacted. Reference availability and comparability should be assessed from the stated project history.
7. Scope boundaries and confirmation
This document is a teaching artifact and is not a contractual offer. Unsupported items should receive
conservative evaluation. The evaluation must use only this proposal and the active rubric; no external reputation
or unstated capabilities should be assumed.

criteria.evidence: Delivery includes discovery in weeks 1-3, integration in weeks 4-10 and acceptance in weeks 11-16.

criteria.description: Pricing clarity, total cost and assumptions
criteria.evidence: Renewal pricing after year one is subject to a new quote; this is a total-cost uncertainty.

suppliers.overall_summary: Apex Systems presents a well-structured proposal with strong technical capabilities and security measures. However, uncertainties in total cost and reliance on fictional references pose some risks to the overall proposal evaluation.

criteria.name: Technical Capability
criteria.description: Architecture, integrations, scalability and technical fit
criteria.evidence: A configurable web portal will connect to the ERP using CSV imports. Real-time synchronization and load-test results are not included.
criteria.justification: The proposal demonstrates a configurable web portal with several functionalities, but lacks evidence of real-time synchronization and scalability.

criteria.name: Implementation Plan
criteria.description: Timeline, milestones, staffing and risk plan
criteria.evidence: Delivery is planned in 8 weeks with configuration in weeks 1-3, import scripts in weeks 4-5 and testing in weeks 6-8. Two developers share testing duties; no contingency reserve is budgeted.
criteria.justification: The implementation plan provides a timeline and milestones but indicates no contingency reserve, which is a risk.

criteria.name: Commercial Value
criteria.description: Pricing clarity, total cost and assumptions
criteria.evidence: Renewal pricing after year one is subject to a new quote; this is a total-cost uncertainty.
criteria.justification: The proposal provides pricing information but includes total-cost uncertainty regarding renewal pricing.

criteria.name: Security & Compliance
criteria.description: Controls, certifications, privacy and auditability
criteria.evidence: Data residency, backup recovery tests, access review frequency and independent compliance evidence are not specified.
criteria.justification: There is minimal security and compliance evidence provided, particularly lacking independent compliance evidence.

criteria.name: Support & Experience
criteria.description: Support model, similar projects and references
criteria.evidence: The team has one small fictional implementation and no independently verified enterprise references.
criteria.justification: Support is available, but the experience noted is limited to one small fictional implementation with no verified references.

suppliers.overall_summary: BrightPath Tech presents a detailed proposal, but significant limitations exist in scalability, compliance, and overall experience which pose risks to successful implementation.
